lines.zh: 我在暗处走动，脚不沾地。
lines.en: I move in the dark; my feet do not quite touch.

lines.zh: 长耳朵晃着，像两根断线。
lines.en: My long ears sway like cut cords.
I pass through a corner's shadow.
One step, and a light dims.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可你回头我就到了。
lines.en: Slow steps, yet I am there when you look back.

lines.zh: 身体是紫黑色的，边缘在散。
lines.en: My body fades at the edges.
I circle the outer hall.

lines.zh: 金属关节发出很轻的响。
lines.en: My joints make the softest click.
I leave no footprints.
I slide along the floor.
My shadow reaches the door first.
I stop, then fade.
Standing, my eyes catch no light.

lines.zh: 这里的光，不太愿意靠近我。
lines.en: The light keeps its distance.
My ears do not move.

lines.zh: 暗影里，我的耳朵动了动。
lines.en: In the dark, my ears twitch.
I am darker than the walls.

lines.zh: 关节里积了灰，我抬了抬手。
lines.en: Dust in my joints, I lift a hand.

lines.zh: 这个角落里，我待得最好。
lines.en: I fit best in this corner.
I do not breathe, and I am not cold.
I tilt my head.
You have seen me.
Do not look back.

lines.zh: 暗影的布料，一扯就散成灰。
lines.en: Shadow cloth tears into ash.
My ears are longer than your arm.
This darkness will not wipe off.
Why do you dare not blink?
Your shadow is changing.
Come a little this way.
It is easier to talk when the lights go out.
I know your name.
You touched me.
My edges frayed a little.
Not pain. Just strange.
A bit of the dark is missing.
Your hand is warm. Take it back.
The violet part has faded.
I tilt my head.
I have not scattered yet.
What is that in your hand?
Give it, and I will withdraw.
I smell it. Sweet.
Set it on the floor.
This thing glows.
Something rattles in your pocket.
I can see it even in the dark.
I will not eat it, but I want it.
Hold it out a little further.
This buys your life.

lines.zh: 你刚才从我身上穿过去了。
lines.en: You passed right through me.
I did not move at all.
Do not push. I am a shadow.
Your hand is too warm.
You hit the wall.
I am here, and not here.
Steady. Do not grope about.
That bump means nothing to me.
My violet edge brushed you.
Go around me.
I have no such part on me.
This body is plastic.
Even my shadow is incomplete.

lines.zh: 影子里的兔子，别提那种事。
lines.en: The shadow rabbit, do not bring that up.
The dark needs none of it.
You have the wrong creature.
I have only one thought.
You cannot touch me. Then what?
The subject makes me colder.
Keep away from me.
This thing casts no shadow.
I grabbed, and my hand passed through.
It darkens in my hand.
This one is mine.
I swallow it into the dark.
The floor is bitterly cold.
I bend, and my edges fray.
Where is that sound coming from?
Give it to me and I release that.
I keep it. No one takes it.

lines.zh: 你打了我，我就一直跟着你。
lines.en: You struck me, so I follow you from now on.
You are already in my reach.
Do not run for that door.
You will not slip away again.

lines.zh: 你的心跳太快了，影子听得见。
lines.en: Your heart beats too fast; the shadow hears it.
I have blocked the lamp.
Come here. It will be quick.
Shadow scraps, pieced into me.
You need not look behind you.
Every shadow bends toward you.
I have already moved.
That one caught you.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，灯就暗一格。
lines.en: Where I pass, the lights dim one step.
I have sealed the way out.
Do not shout. No one hears.
We begin right now.
I stay at your back.
Each step you take, I take one.
I press into the corner and let you pass.

lines.zh: 走廊的灯在我经过时灭。
lines.en: Lights die as I pass.
I listen to your breathing.
Your hand is hunting for a door.
The door is ahead, and locked.
My ears droop.
You are already tiring.
I need not chase. You cannot escape.
Only one set of footsteps on the floor.
I count only to three.
There is one more shadow on the wall.
Now. Turn your head.

lines.zh: 我的手指已经碰到你了。
lines.en: My fingers have touched you.
You are far too late.
Your shadow has stopped.
This one has a grip on you.
I seize your collar.
My fingers pass into your shoulder and grip.
You are dragged into the dark.

lines.zh: 爪子划过，一点声音也没有。
lines.en: My claws sweep past without a sound.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵抽在你的脸上。
lines.en: An ear whips across your face.
You are flat against the wall.
I tear your sleeve open.
You cannot see my hand.
Blood is also black in the dark.
I let go, and you stay upright.
You retreat; I follow.
I cover your face with my palm.
The other hand comes from the side.

lines.zh: 我的脚踩在你的影子上。
lines.en: My foot pins your shadow.

lines.zh: 我低头，耳朵扫过你的肩。
lines.en: I lower my head; an ear sweeps your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你抓不到我，我却抓得到你。
lines.en: You cannot grip me. I can grip you.
I drag you toward the door.
A fist lands on your back.
I made a sound. Only once.
I come from where I was.
One flicker, and here I am.
I am Shadow Bonnie.
I rise from beside the wall.
The dark here is not thick enough.
No one called me. I am still here.
My ears touch the ceiling.
Come here. Do not run.
I do not belong here. Yet I am here.
This hand is a little cold.
Fire thins me by a layer.
On landing, my edges fray.

lines.zh: 水里有影子，可我不在里面。
lines.en: There are shadows in water. I am not among them.
The flash pushes me away.
The arrow passed through me.
This light recognizes me.
I do not eat, yet I fade.

lines.zh: 电让我全身发亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning makes me flare once.
I was always like the void.
